parser.preparationWhy: Rhino 1.9.2 refuses const in a for…of head and scopes a const to its whole function (a const declared again in a sibling block is a redeclaration error for its parser, not in JavaScript); the reader reads const from the source text

accepted.construct: const x = e | let x = e | let x

accepted.limits: one level, no default, no rest

accepted.construct: x = e | local.x = e | local.o.k = e
x += e | x -= e | x *= e | x /= e | x++ | x-- | o.f++ | o.f += e (a field of a local object or of result)
accepted.lowering: local.x = local.x + (e); x++ is local.x = Number(local.x) + 1 (JavaScript converts to a number first); x-- is local.x = local.x - 1; o.f++ is local.o.f = Number(local.o.f) + 1, the object being shared as in JavaScript (an object read from a map is that object)

a list method or a global call that the condition always evaluates (not in the right operand of && || ??, a branch of ?:, a call argument or an arrow) runs before the if in local.__chain<N>; an else if condition inside its else

accepted.where: no list method or global call in the condition (FLOWSCRIPT_V3_CHAIN): it is evaluated before every pass

accepted.lowering: item read as current in its own body; when a nested construct rebinds current and reads the outer item, copy it to local.item at the start of the outer body; one-level destructured fields are copied from current.field; items may be Object.keys(o), Object.values(o) or a list method chain (filter, map, toSorted, sort, concat), computed once before the loop in local.__chain<N>

accepted.construct: for (let i = a; i < b; i++) {…}
accepted.limits: < or <=, step ++, i not assigned in the body; maxIterations 1000000
accepted.lowering: local.i = a; while (i < b) { body; local.i = Number(local.i) + 1 }; when continue leaves the loop body: local.__count<N> = a; while (__count < b) { local.i = __count; __count = Number(__count) + 1; body } (continue is next), the bound read at every test as in JavaScript

accepted.limits: literal labels, every case ends with break/return/throw, default last

accepted.lowering: error = local.e (local.error without parameter); e read inside catch only

accepted.where: while, for…of or counted for, no label
e is the parameter of the enclosing catch, not assigned

accepted.construct: xs.toSorted(cmp) | [...xs].sort(cmp), cmp = c1 || c2 || …, each ci: a.k - b.k | a.k.localeCompare(b.k) (String() allowed) | a.k < b.k ? -1 : a.k > b.k ? 1 : 0 and every ternary of <, >, <=, >=, ==, !=, ===, !== tests on the two keys with number results that gives its sign for every pair of values; b before a for descending; a and b alone for the items themselves

properties.by: current.k for the first key; omitted for an identity comparator (the block uses current)
properties.compare: number (a - b) | locale (localeCompare) | natural (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0, raw keys)
properties.then: [{ by, compare, direction }, …] for c2, c3…, evaluated literally as c1 || c2 || … (a 0 or NaN falls to the next key)

accepted.note: a copy sorted by the engine's Array.prototype.sort with the arrow's comparator (stable; NaN compares equal); a ternary comparator is checked on the eight classes of a pair of keys (less, greater, and equal or incomparable with ===, == only or neither); without compare list.sort keeps its Flow order

accepted.lowering: one node per block step, linked by local.__chain<N>
accepted.where: assignment or return; a value that is entirely c ? a : b with a step in a branch lowers to if (c) { x = a } else { x = b }; not in other branches of ?: && || ??, not in an expression function argument, not after a scope read of the statement

accepted.lowering: the expression method (Array.prototype.concat: a list argument is spread, another value appended as one item); list method chains in the arguments run before it, after the chain of xs

accepted.where: rows created by json.array, or by const rows = [] / let rows = [] whose item type every push proves

accepted.construct: const rows = [] | let rows = [] followed by rows.push(v)
accepted.lowering: local.rows = json.array({ itemType }) with the type every pushed value has from its syntax (string and template literals, number literals, booleans, comparisons, !, typeof, null as nullable, object literals whose fields of certain type become properties, list literals); a later rows = [] or list literal joins the inference
accepted.where: json.array admits no item type that accepts any value (unknown is refused: UNKNOWN_VALUE_TYPE); otherwise FLOWSCRIPT_V3_UNTYPED_LIST with the json.array proposal
assignment, return, chain head, if condition, for…of list
assignment, return, chain head, if condition, for…of list
assignment, return, chain head, if condition
assignment, return, chain head, if condition

accepted.lowering: expression function default (null, undefined and "" replaced)
accepted.where: any expression; a bare default( is refused (FLOWSCRIPT_V3_RESERVED_WORD)

properties beyond the JavaScript form; slots keep $$ keys, each written $$s() { … }, $$s: function () { … } or $$s: () => { … } without parameter; declared, assigned or returned, the call writes its output with $$out

accepted.construct: // text or /* text */ above a statement, no blank line
accepted.lowering: node comment (formatter writes // lines); standalone comment node after a blank line

accepted.construct: function helper({ a, b }) { … } after the Flow function, called helper({ a: 1 })
accepted.lowering: helper block, as in v2; body under the same rules

refused.construct: import … from "…"
declaring or importing flow, a scope name, or a local starting with __
default(x, y) outside a switch: default is a reserved word, so this is not JavaScript
refused.rewrite: flow.default(x, y), with the same arguments

refused.construct: a local named like a block namespace the Flow uses (text, list, json…)
x and local.x in the same Flow
a name read outside the block that declares it
refused.rewrite: declare it in the enclosing block

refused.construct: a name declared again in an enclosed block, or hiding an import or a loop variable
assigning a const
destructuring with default, rest or nesting
x++ or x += e inside an expression
result.x = … and return { … } in the same Flow
break
refused.rewrite: a local tested by the while condition, or find / filter

refused.construct: finally
return inside a loop
refused.rewrite: continue, or a local and a return after the loop

refused.construct: a for (;;) other than for (let i = a; i < b; i++), or a counter assigned in the body
refused.rewrite: for…of, or a while with a local the body changes

refused.construct: switch with fall-through, non-literal case or default not last
do … while, for … in, labelled loop, labelled break or continue
a function other than a top-level helper, a list arrow or a slot: nested, in an expression, a closure; a slot arrow with an expression body, a slot with a parameter
refused.rewrite: inline, a top-level helper, or a project block; a slot: $$s() { … }, $$s: function () { … } or $$s: () => { … }

refused.construct: a block method in a branch of ?: inside a larger expression, in a branch of && || ??, in the test of ?:, in an expression function argument, or after a scope read of the statement; a list method or global call in a while condition (proposal: a let computed before the loop and at the end of the body)
xs.sort alone, a comparator that is not exactly one of the key orders (for instance a.k === b.k ? 0 : …, a.k < b.k ? -1 : 1), reduce, (x, i), outer arrow parameter in an inner arrow
refused.rewrite: toSorted with a.k - b.k, localeCompare or a.k < b.k ? -1 : a.k > b.k ? 1 : 0 joined by ||, list.sum, list.map or a loop

refused.construct: const rows = [] then rows.push(v) when a pushed or assigned value has no certain type, or the values disagree; push on a list not created by json.array or []
refused.rewrite: json.array({ itemType }) with the type of the pushed values (CHOOSE_TYPE when it cannot be proposed)

refused.construct: Object.* or JSON.* elsewhere or with other arguments, Object.entries, Date.now, new Date
throw new Error(m)
async, await, generators, classes, this, new, const without a value, o.f++ on a field of a loop item or of input
if or while whose condition is an object literal

valueRules: paths are null-safe (undefined instead of a TypeError)
<, <=, >, >= compare two numeric texts as numbers
a template literal writes null and undefined as "", objects and lists as JSON
loops have an execution budget: while 1000 passes and 60 s unless flow.while sets other bounds; counted for 1000000 passes

rendering.default: natural JavaScript form wherever the meaning is identical, call form otherwise; author forms kept through __flowScript* node fields

names.loopVariable: item, then item2, item3… when visible

conformance.why: Rhino 1.9.2 keeps the first value of a const declared in a block nested in a loop (#326); v3 lowers each declaration to an assignment at every pass
conformance.rule: run by the Flow engine from the lowered tree, never by evaluating the text with Rhino; no const is rewritten

conformance.why: flow.default is the v2 default function written as JavaScript: undefined, null and "" give the fallback, in any expression; a bare default( is a reserved word, not a call
conformance.rule: the source is read by the Rhino 1.9.2 parser (ES6) as written, without preparation or error; run by the Flow engine from the lowered tree

conformance.why: Rhino 1.9.2 scopes a const to its whole function: a const declared again in a sibling block or a later for…of is a redeclaration for its parser, while JavaScript scopes each one to its block (the L3 bench refusal of 18/11)
conformance.rule: parsed after the same-length preparation that writes each const declaration keyword as let; each declaration keeps its const rule
